findings.description: No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest by default.

findings.issue_category: no public access block / ACL restriction
findings.description: The bucket has no explicit ACL and no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource, leaving it potentially exposed to default/public access settings and no defense-in-depth against accidental public exposure.
The bucket stores what appears to be sensitive financial ledger export data but has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving data unencrypted at rest.
No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is associated with this bucket to prevent accidental public exposure of sensitive ledger data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, so model artifacts are stored unencrypted at rest.
No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource is defined to prevent accidental public exposure.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving operational runbook data unencrypted at rest.
No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource is defined to prevent accidental public exposure of the bucket.

findings.issue_category: insecure ACL for log delivery bucket
findings.description: The bucket uses the 'log-delivery-write' canned ACL without an accompanying aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block, which can allow broader write access than intended for a sensitive audit trail bucket.

The object is uploaded to a bucket (reports_archive) that has no server-side encryption configured, and the object itself does not specify server_side_encryption or kms_key_id, so the uploaded file is stored unencrypted.

findings.issue_category: force_destroy enabled on sensitive data bucket
findings.description: force_destroy = true allows the bucket and all its contents to be permanently deleted without additional confirmation, risking irreversible data loss of reports data.

findings.issue_category: force_destroy enabled on sensitive data bucket
findings.description: force_destroy = true permits deletion of the bucket and all ledger export data without additional safeguards, increasing risk of irrecoverable data loss for financial records.
